factual_claims.source_evidence: For subsidiary Heimstaden Bostad, financing markets remained strong, with SEK 44,900 million of asset-backed financing... SEK 14,600 million of capital markets issuance... Outstanding Green Bonds SEK m 13,767 315

factual_claims.claim: Fitch affirmed Heimstaden’s B- rating but revised the outlook to Negative.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: In January 2025, Fitch ratings affirmed the ‘B-‘ and revised the Outlook to Negative for Heimstaden

factual_claims.claim: No dividend was proposed for any share class.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: It is proposed that the funds at the disposal of the Annual General Meeting of SEK 19,546,645,879 is to be carried forward. No dividend shall be paid to any of the Share Classes.

numerical_claims.claim: Rental income was SEK 15,916 million, essentially flat versus SEK 15,919 million in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT

numerical_claims.claim: Annualised like-for-like rental growth was 4.9%, down from 5.6%, while real economic occupancy remained stable at 98.5%.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT

numerical_claims.claim: Fourth-quarter rental income declined 3.4% to SEK 3,945 million, although quarterly occupancy improved to 98.7%.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT

numerical_claims.claim: Net operating income increased to SEK 11,475 million from SEK 11,188 million, and the NOI margin rose to 72.1% from 70.3%.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT

numerical_claims.claim: The improvement reflected a 6.1% reduction in property expenses to SEK 4,378 million, attributed to cost-control measures, digitalisation, operating efficiencies, and the smaller portfolio following property sales.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Property expenses decreased by 6.1% to SEK 4,378 million (4,661)

numerical_claims.claim: Utilities were an exception, increasing 5.7% because municipal price increases exceeded core inflation.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: For the year, utilities increased by 5.7% to SEK 1,095 million (1,036)

numerical_claims.claim: Capital expenditures were SEK 4,439 million, while tenant-improvement investments generated SEK 94 million of additional rental income at an average yield on cost of 10.8%.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT

numerical_claims.claim: The group’s reported profit before tax rose to SEK 16,012 million from SEK 10,403 million, and profit for the year increased to SEK 13,056 million from SEK 7,621 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Profit before tax was SEK 16,012 million (10,403)

numerical_claims.claim: The result benefited from a SEK 9,498 million fair-value gain on investment properties, compared with SEK 8,554 million in 2024, and realised property-divestment gains of SEK 2,207 million versus SEK 1,687 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Change in fair value of investment properties, for the year were SEK 9,498 million (8,553)

numerical_claims.claim: A SEK 3,996 million foreign-exchange gain also compared with a SEK 2,038 million loss in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT

numerical_claims.claim: These gains were partly offset by a SEK 3,707 million goodwill impairment, primarily relating to Germany and Sweden, following higher discount rates in the Akelius goodwill impairment test.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT

numerical_claims.claim: Total comprehensive income fell to SEK 4,199 million from SEK 11,082 million because currency translation differences shifted to a SEK 8,857 million loss from a SEK 3,461 million gain.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT

numerical_claims.claim: The privatisation programme remained central to capital allocation: 2,466 units were sold for SEK 10,664 million at a 28.9% premium to book value.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Privatisation sales of SEK 10,664 million; 2,466 residential units sold at a 28.9% premium to book value

numerical_claims.claim: Divestments reduced rental income by SEK 538 million but generated proceeds used to reduce debt.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Divestments For the year, impact from divestments on rental income was SEK -538 million

numerical_claims.claim: Interest-bearing liabilities declined to SEK 175,227 million from SEK 195,816 million, reducing net LTV to 52.2% from 56.4% and improving ICR to 2.0x from 1.9x.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT

numerical_claims.claim: Financing activity remained substantial, including SEK 59,500 million raised or refinanced by Heimstaden Bostad and SEK 13,767 million of outstanding green bonds.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: For subsidiary Heimstaden Bostad, financing markets remained strong, with SEK 44,900 million of asset-backed financing across 24 transactions and SEK 14,600 million of capital markets issuance across seven transactions (six being green)...
